title.en: Point the form at the https address and add HSTS

detail.en: Change the form action to the https address so nothing is sent over the redirect. Then add HSTS, so browsers never try http again.

forwardable.en: Or forward it to your developer — it reads the same either way.

body.en:
On {{domain}} the form at {{form_path}} posts to {{post_url_http}}, which redirects to {{post_url_https}}. The first request carries {{fields}} in the clear.

Change the form action to post directly to {{post_url_https}} so nothing travels over the redirect. Then add a Strict-Transport-Security response header with max-age of at least 63072000, including subdomains.

When you are done: tell me which files you changed and how to confirm no request from this form leaves over plain http.
